_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment + ADR-031 declarative intake lifecycle + ADR-091 the shop connection lives in integriq
_meta.description: Web shop order intake: WebshopOrder (the contract integriq's shop connector writes), WebshopChannel (one per connected shop) and the ARInvoice.webshop group (REQ-SWO-001, REQ-SWO-006).

WebshopOrder.title: Web shop order
WebshopOrder.description: One order as a web shop sent it, written by integriq's shop connector into register shillinq. The schema is the intake contract (docs/integrations/webshop-order-intake.md). Shillinq turns a received order into one issued ARInvoice, once per channel and shop order number.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a web shop order is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail.

received.label: Received
received.description: Written by the shop connector; not yet invoiced.

invoiced.label: Invoiced
invoiced.description: One ARInvoice was written for this order; arInvoiceId points to it.

duplicate.label: Duplicate
duplicate.description: The same channel and shop order number was received before; no invoice was written.

credited.label: Credited
credited.description: Refunded or cancelled after invoicing; creditNoteId points to the credit note.

invoice.label: Invoice
invoice.description: The invoicer wrote the order's invoice.

refuse.label: Refuse
refuse.description: The order cannot be invoiced: unknown channel, no lines, totals that do not add up, or no VAT route.

markDuplicate.label: Mark duplicate
markDuplicate.description: The channel already has an order with this shop order number.

credit.label: Credit
credit.description: The shop refunded or cancelled the order and a credit note was written.

onRefused.description: Tell the bookkeepers of the administration that a web shop order was refused, with the reason.

channelId.description: FK to the WebshopChannel this order came through. An order for an unknown channel is refused.
channelId.title: Channel

shopOrderId.description: The shop's own order number. With channelId it is the idempotency key: a second record with the same pair is a duplicate and writes no invoice.
shopOrderId.title: Shop order number

orderedAt.description: When the buyer placed the order in the shop.
orderedAt.title: Ordered at

buyer.title: Buyer
buyer.description: The buyer as the shop sent it.

type.description: A business is matched to or created as a CustomerMaster; a consumer is booked on the channel's collective debtor.
type.title: Buyer type

name.description: The buyer's name, kept on the invoice.
name.title: Name

companyName.description: The company name of a business buyer.
companyName.title: Company name

vatId.description: The VAT id of a business buyer, matched first.
vatId.title: VAT id

kvkNumber.description: The KvK number of a business buyer, matched second.
kvkNumber.title: KvK number

address.description: The buyer's address as one text, kept on the invoice.
address.title: Address

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the buyer; drives the VAT route.
countryCode.title: Country

pricesIncludeVat.description: Whether unitPrice, shipping and totals include VAT; the net price is derived by dividing out each line's rate.
pricesIncludeVat.title: Prices include VAT

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: The order lines as the shop sent them.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit, with or without VAT as pricesIncludeVat says.
unitPrice.title: Unit price

vatRate.description: The line's VAT rate in percent as the shop applied it.
vatRate.title: VAT rate

shipping.description: The shipping charge, with or without VAT as pricesIncludeVat says.
shipping.title: Shipping

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: The order totals as the shop sent them; the lines must add up to them.

payment.title: Payment
payment.description: The payment state the shop reports.

status.description: paid settles the invoice on the clearing account; refunded or cancelled writes a credit note.
status.title: Payment status

method.description: The payment method, such as ideal.
method.title: Method

providerPaymentId.description: The payment provider's id, kept on the invoice for the payout match.
providerPaymentId.title: Provider payment id

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration the order is booked in; the channel's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration

intakeState.description: Shillinq's own intake state; managed by the lifecycle, never written by the shop connector.
intakeState.title: Intake state

arInvoiceId.description: FK to the ARInvoice written for this order.
arInvoiceId.title: Invoice

creditNoteId.description: FK to the credit note written on refund or cancellation.
creditNoteId.title: Credit note

refusalReason.description: Why the order was refused, naming the problem and both totals where they differ.
refusalReason.title: Refusal reason

WebshopChannel.title: Web shop channel
WebshopChannel.description: One connected web shop: what the shop does not know but the invoice needs. An order whose channel is unknown is refused.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a web shop channel is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail.

name.description: The shop's name, such as its domain.
name.title: Name

platform.description: The shop platform integriq connects to.
platform.title: Platform

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration the shop's orders are booked in.
administrationId.title: Administration

consumerDebtorId.description: FK to the CustomerMaster that collects the consumer orders (verzameldebiteur).
consumerDebtorId.title: Consumer debtor

revenueAccount.description: The revenue account the order lines are booked on.
revenueAccount.title: Revenue account

shippingAccount.description: The revenue account the shipping charge is booked on.
shippingAccount.title: Shipping account

clearingAccount.description: The payment clearing account a paid order is settled on.
clearingAccount.title: Clearing account

issueMode.description: auto-issue issues the invoice at once; draft-for-review leaves it a draft.
issueMode.title: Issue mode

webshop.title: Web shop
webshop.description: Where an invoice written from a web shop order came from.

orderId.description: FK to the WebshopOrder the invoice was written for.
orderId.title: Order

buyerName.description: The consumer's name on an invoice booked on the collective debtor.
buyerName.title: Buyer name

paymentReference.description: The payment provider's id, kept for the payout match.
paymentReference.title: Payment reference
